Requirement: Authenticate users and enforce the documented four role permission matrix
Acceptance criteria: Unauthenticated requests return 401; test UI and direct API for all role and action combinations including cross team denial; administrator gets no call content merely by holding the admin role.

Requirement: Import sales data from CSV using a documented schema
Acceptance criteria: A fixture of 100 valid rows imports once; repeating its import creates no duplicates; invalid rows return row numbers and reasons without partial unreported writes.

Requirement: Associate call audio with a sales record through explicit identifiers
Acceptance criteria: Each accepted call has unique call_id and an existing deal_id; ambiguous or missing joins are rejected for correction; no guessed joins.

Requirement: Accept consented WAV and MP3 recordings for asynchronous processing
Acceptance criteria: After upload and validation complete a valid 10 minute file returns job_id and status within 2 seconds on the agreed host; measure upload duration separately; files above 50 MB or 30 minutes and unsupported types are rejected.

Requirement: Expose processing status and recoverable failures
Acceptance criteria: Each job follows queued processing completed or failed states; repeated requests do not duplicate results; a transient error retries at most twice; a permanent error displays a useful message.

Requirement: Produce editable timestamped transcripts with language metadata
Acceptance criteria: A completed job stores segment start end text model version and declared language; every segment satisfies 0 <= start < end <= call duration; unsupported language produces an explicit result.

Requirement: Distinguish anonymous speakers and permit correction
Acceptance criteria: A two speaker test call displays speaker A and B; reviewer can correct a speaker label; identity and role are never inferred as fact without confirmation.

Requirement: Extract sales objections and next actions with evidence
Acceptance criteria: Every displayed objection or next action links to an existing transcript segment and timestamp; unsupported or uncertain items are flagged; missing evidence prevents publication as confirmed.

Requirement: Let an authorized reviewer correct and approve extracted items
Acceptance criteria: A correction creates a new revision with actor time old value and new value; the UI distinguishes draft reviewed and corrected items.

Requirement: Display reproducible sales and call analytics
Acceptance criteria: For a fixed 20 deal fixture count won lost eligible closed deals and won divided by won plus lost exactly match hand calculation; filters by date representative and outcome update all charts consistently.

Requirement: Search permitted transcripts and filter the call list
Acceptance criteria: A known keyword returns all matching authorized fixture calls; date language status and outcome filters compose; a salesperson never receives unauthorized results.

Requirement: Export permitted analytics with provenance
Acceptance criteria: CSV export matches the active filters and contains metric definition time window and data version; spreadsheet formula prefixes in untrusted text are safely neutralized.

Requirement: Support retention and deletion of a call and its derivatives
Acceptance criteria: A deletion removes audio all transcript versions extracted items revision old and new text search indexes and application export caches within 24 hours; retain content free audit only; backup expiry <=30 days. Previously downloaded exports require an owner policy.

Requirement: Keep CRM outcomes distinct from conversation inferences
Acceptance criteria: The source outcome field cannot be overwritten by model output; the UI labels extraction as a draft inference and reports absent outcome as unknown rather than lost.

Requirement: Measure model performance by language and call conditions
Acceptance criteria: An evaluation run exports per language WER entity accuracy extraction macro F1 and processing time with dataset split model configuration and unsupported strata shown explicitly.

Requirement: Import from a live CRM connector
Acceptance criteria: A future read only connector uses scoped credentials and idempotent synchronization; CSV remains the mandatory initial path.

Requirement: Privacy and data minimization
Acceptance criteria: Only recordings with a recorded authorization basis enter the pilot; raw customer contacts are excluded from source control and evaluation exports; retention settings and deletion are demonstrable.

Requirement: Transport storage and secret protection
Acceptance criteria: Deployed endpoints require TLS; object storage is private; no secrets in tracked example files; runtime credentials have minimum permissions. Local mockup contains synthetic data only.

Requirement: Auditability and reproducibility
Acceptance criteria: Every inference stores model name version configuration hash input checksum transcript revision and processing time; each reported metric names its denominator and dataset version.

Requirement: Dashboard response time
Acceptance criteria: For 10000 synthetic deal rows and 1000 call records on a documented 4 vCPU 8 GB RAM reference machine, p95 dashboard API response <=2 seconds across 100 requests at concurrency 5; inference runs separately.

Requirement: Transcription processing time
Acceptance criteria: On the separately recorded inference host, median real time factor <=1 for 10 minute pilot recordings and p95 <=2; model size hardware audio length and warm up are reported. This is a proposed target, not a measured result.

Requirement: Failure isolation and consistency
Acceptance criteria: An interrupted worker can restart without duplicate transcript versions becoming current; failed jobs do not appear as completed; database and blob cleanup are reconciled.

Requirement: Usability and accessibility
Acceptance criteria: At least 4 of 5 users finish the three fixed tasks in the evaluation plan without help within 10 minutes total; use preprocessed 2 minute synthetic or authorized calls and exclude ASR waiting; keyboard interactions and field errors are usable.

Requirement: Maintainability
Acceptance criteria: Documented module interfaces configuration examples schema migrations lint checks and tests exist before integration; a teammate can reproduce the demo from README instructions.

Requirement: Language quality
Acceptance criteria: Pilot targets WER <=25% for Russian and <=30% for Kazakh; report each language separately with uncertainty and test size. Failure triggers transcript correction scope or a narrower supported language claim.

Requirement: Factual reliability
Acceptance criteria: On held out annotated calls, >=95% of extracted items must have correct supporting evidence and zero fabricated numeric commitments in the reviewed sample; reviewers verify all numeric commitments before release.
